lines.text: The good ending plays in full.
After the closing card, there is one more scene.
Aunty Soma takes something from her purse. A voter registration card. Worn. The laminate is separating at the corners.

lines.speaker: Aunty Soma
lines.text: From 1983. The first time I voted.

lines.speaker: Aunty Soma
lines.text: Not the card that matters. The road will probably not be fixed. Mahinda Bandara will probably win again.

lines.speaker: Aunty Soma
lines.text: I come every time anyway. Because the alternative is to let other people make all the decisions. And I have never found a convincing argument for that.
The game ends. No further statistics. No score. Just the closing.
